q1_issues.issue: "Los Angeles Mayor" is recorded as `(Possession richard_riordan los_angeles)`, which asserts a bare possession link between the man and the city rather than relating him to the office he held there.

`Ongoing` is emitted for a bare participial post-modifier ("those awaiting"), which is not one of the four explicit progressive markers the instruction set allows (there is no "is/was V-ing" auxiliary).

q2_gaps: a pre-nominal office title carrying its own place argument ("Los Angeles Mayor Richard Riordan") — the title rule covers only kinship/courtesy titles and offers no way to attach the jurisdiction to the office
privative / temporal "former" before a role noun — no rule; the parse approximates it with `Past`-wrapped atoms
tense/aspect inheritance for a reduced relative clause (the instruction set fixes this only for appositives, which take the host clause's wrapper)
notes: The core predication is right: "those" becomes a `person` group, the fronted "among" membership is recorded with `PartOf` on the named member, and "Schwarzenegger's decision" takes the ordinary genitive `Possession`.
